cards.cardName: Uncle FrizzleBob's Kayfabizarro Komik Kult Kards
cards.lore: The truth isn't hidden in textbooks—it's scribbled in the margins by the people they kicked out of the room.
cards.power: Smashes through the fourth wall to deliver epistemic sabotage directly to the prefrontal cortex.

cards.lore: A game is just a reality you willingly consent to—choose yours carefully.
cards.power: Dictates the mechanics: Cut on the dotted lines, build your deck, and trust no authority.

cards.lore: If you're only looking at the center, you're missing the punchline.
cards.power: Forces the player to observe the margins where the real story is hiding.

cards.lore: The ultimate cosmic joke: Being biologically wired for love in a society built for spreadsheets.
cards.power: Initiates the Human Nature expansion pack, activating all psychology and anthropology discounts.

cards.lore: Darwin knew cooperation wasn't evolution's enemy, but its main engine—sympathetic communities flourish best.
cards.power: When played, all players share one example of cooperation, adding [A+1] to the Stage.

cards.lore: Life conquered the globe not by combat, but through microscopic networking and cellular fusion.
cards.power: Merges two cards on the Stage into a single, dominant entity with combined effects.

cards.lore: Even among pure egoists, the mathematical certainty is that Tit for Tat cooperation wins the long game.
cards.power: Allows you to copy the dice value of a player who helped you; reciprocity becomes your shield.

cards.lore: The Alpha Male myth is a statistical rounding error in an otherwise cooperative biosphere.
cards.power: Synthesizes the board: cancels all active competitive multipliers and resets the baseline to cooperative.

cards.lore: Mirror neurons mean we are biologically designed for social resonance; we literally feel what others feel.
cards.power: Mirrors another player's emotion, granting both [A+1]; failing to mirror costs [A-1].

cards.lore: Social pain is real pain—rejection activates the exact same brain regions as physical injury.
cards.power: Punishes isolation with [F-2], but rewards reconnection immediately with [A+2].

cards.lore: Chronic loneliness destroys the immune system and acts as a biological hunger signal for connection.
cards.power: Marks a player as isolated, aggressively increasing their Fragility [F+2] every turn until they reconnect.

cards.lore: We are not thinking machines that feel; we are feeling machines that occasionally think.
cards.power: Reveals hidden emotional states, allowing players to bypass logical defenses for one round.

cards.lore: Morality isn't trained into us by society—toddlers help instinctively before they can even speak.
cards.power: Morality functions automatically this round; trust replaces all dice rolls and calculation.

cards.lore: We would rather burn our own resources than let an unfair actor walk away unpunished.
cards.power: Sacrifice [A-1] to violently reduce an offender's Rivalry by [R-2]; justice demands a price.

cards.lore: Empathy, consolation, and justice aren't human inventions; they are ancient evolutionary inheritances.
cards.power: Triggers post-conflict reconciliation, restoring [A+2] to both parties and erasing conflict memory.

cards.lore: True justice is a biological reflex, part nurturing hug, part spiteful rejection of the greedy.
cards.power: Rebalances the Stage by redistributing hoarded resources equally among all active players.

cards.lore: The prophet of capitalism actually believed human nature was deeply rooted in empathy; a fact history conveniently forgot.
cards.power: Grants [A+2] if you consider others' welfare before your own; penalizes ignorance with [F-1].

cards.cardName: Gary Becker – Der Homo Oeconomicus Architekt
cards.lore: By reducing all human behavior to a cost-benefit analysis, he built a perfect model of a sociopath.
cards.power: Turns all actions into transactions; buys cooperation with [R+2], but permanently halves all trust effects.

cards.lore: Most cynical proofs of human evil are fabricated myths—deep down, humanity is aggressively decent.
cards.power: Challenges any selfish nature assumption; if debunked, all players gain [A+1] and [F-1].

cards.lore: We built an entire global economic system for a species that doesn't actually exist.
cards.power: Disables all purely transactional or selfish multipliers on the board for three consecutive rounds.

cards.lore: True altruism exists. We don't just help to feel good; we help because genuine empathy compels action.
cards.power: Lose [A-1] to give another [A+2]; if they pay it forward, you reap a massive [F-2] reward.

cards.lore: We are born helpers; toddlers will drop everything to assist a stranger without any promise of a reward.
cards.power: The first helpful action in a round automatically succeeds without a dice roll; purity bypasses calculation.

cards.lore: Evolution hardwired generosity to the same neurological pleasure centers as food and sex.
cards.power: Give away a card to trigger your brain's reward center; immediately gain [A+2] and [F-1].

cards.lore: Selflessness isn't a sacrifice; it is the most sophisticated dopamine hack in evolutionary history.
cards.power: Any altruistic action taken this round doubles in power and creates a cascading benefit to the next player.

cards.lore: The Overjustification Effect: paying someone to do what they love is the fastest way to kill their passion.
cards.power: Roll with advantage if acting from genuine interest; roll with disadvantage if bribed.

cards.lore: The rational market is a joke; huge financial bonuses reliably cause performance-destroying panic.
cards.power: If offered a massive reward [R+2], you choke under pressure: roll twice and take the worse result.

cards.lore: Motivation Crowding Theory: putting a price tag on a civic duty destroys the moral desire to do it.
cards.power: Monetizing any cooperative action this round degrades all [A] values by 1.

cards.lore: Carrots and sticks are for donkeys; meaning and autonomy are for living beings.
cards.power: Strips all financial and external reward buffs from the Stage, forcing players to rely purely on base stats.

cards.lore: Surveillance capitalism doesn't want your money—it wants to mine your behavior, predict your future, and sell it.
cards.power: Reveals all hidden tech influences for one round; choose to resist [R+1] or tragically comply [A-1].

cards.lore: Since 2010, the invisible umbilical cord to our screens has been silently mass-producing loneliness and anxiety.
cards.power: Every screen-based artifact on the Stage actively increases Fragility [F+1] for all players.

cards.lore: We are no longer exploited by cruel masters; we are the cheerful, self-optimizing architects of our own burnout.
cards.power: Pushing yourself beyond limits [R+4] causes immediate burnout, draining [F-3].

cards.lore: The modern world is a beautifully designed Skinner box, and we are paying a monthly subscription to stay inside.
cards.power: Traps all players in an algorithmic feedback loop, restricting moves until a Disconnect action is taken.

cards.lore: The belief that you are unfinished is infinitely more powerful than the belief that you are gifted.
cards.power: Reframes any failed roll as learning, banking an [A+2] bonus for your next related action.

cards.lore: The Pygmalion Effect: Our expectations of others literally alter their reality and capabilities.
cards.power: Declare a positive expectation about another player; if they believe it, both gain [A+1] and [F-1].

cards.lore: Helplessness can be learned, but so can optimism—hope is a muscle that must be violently exercised.
cards.power: Use a past failure token to prevent a current collapse. Learned resilience is the ultimate shield.

cards.lore: Mindfulness isn't meditation; it is the radical, reality-bending power of simply paying attention to the present.
cards.power: Notice one missed detail on the Stage to completely reinterpret its meaning, shifting the game context.
